denominator_rule: count dependency relations with both latest observed version ordinal and supported major evidence; null when none are assessable

output.denominator: adoption relations with both latest version ordinal and supported major evidence
output.numerator: assessed adoption relations whose latest observed version major equals the explicitly supplied supported major

params.supported_major_semantics: latest version major equals the supplied supported major

status_note: published in rh-adoption-result/1 as an exact numerator/denominator ratio; missing supported-line evidence is excluded from the denominator and an empty denominator is not_applicable
